repositories.name: rtk
repositories.summary: Rust CLI proxy that filters and compresses command output before it enters agent context.
repositories.reported_result: Maintainer reports roughly 60–90% command-output reduction; external pilots show operation-level savings may not reduce task-level billing.
repositories.main_caveat: Command coverage and task-level turn count determine actual provider-billed savings.

repositories.name: tokless
repositories.summary: Installer for a token-saving stack across Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, and Antigravity.
repositories.mechanism: Bundles RTK, Caveman, CodeGraph, and Context-Mode style tools.
repositories.reported_result: Stack-level claims are inherited from components.
repositories.main_caveat: Bundle is reference solution, not an atomic technique.

repositories.name: agentic-token-bench
repositories.summary: Benchmark and installer framework for measuring token-saving CLI tools in agentic coding workflows.
repositories.mechanism: Runs deterministic before/after comparisons for selected CLI primitives and token-saving tools.
repositories.reported_result: README reports 65.1–99.2% reductions for six CLI tools on pinned Cassandra tasks.
repositories.main_caveat: Task-level artifact reduction is not automatically end-to-end session savings.
